performance_optimizations.title: Memoize getModelMetadata() to prevent expensive object recreation
performance_optimizations.description: The `getModelMetadata()` function in `modelRouter.ts` creates a new object containing 40+ model definitions on every single call. This function is called during model selection, cost estimation, and UI rendering, causing significant memory churn and CPU overhead.
performance_optimizations.rationale: Each call creates ~2KB of new objects that immediately become garbage. With frequent calls during model selection/display, this creates GC pressure and unnecessary computation. The model data is static and never changes at runtime, making it a perfect candidate for memoization.
performance_optimizations.currentMetric: ~40+ object allocations per getModelMetadata() call, potentially hundreds of calls during a session
performance_optimizations.expectedImprovement: Reduce memory allocations by 99%, eliminate redundant computation, ~50-100ms faster initial model selection
performance_optimizations.implementation:
1. Move the model metadata object to module-level const declaration
2. Export the constant directly instead of returning from function
3. Alternative: Use a lazy singleton pattern if initialization timing matters
4. Update all callsites to use the constant directly
performance_optimizations.tradeoffs: None - this is pure optimization with no behavioral changes

performance_optimizations.title: Virtualize ImageGallery grid for large collections
performance_optimizations.description: The ImageGallery component renders ALL images in the user's collection at once. For users with 50+ generated images, this causes significant DOM bloat and slow initial render times as each image card creates multiple DOM nodes.
performance_optimizations.rationale: Each image card contains 8+ DOM elements (image, overlays, buttons, badges). With 100 images, that's 800+ DOM nodes always mounted. Virtual scrolling only renders visible items plus a small buffer, typically reducing DOM nodes from 800 to ~40.
performance_optimizations.currentMetric: Full DOM render of all gallery items, ~100ms+ render time for 50+ images
performance_optimizations.expectedImprovement: Constant O(1) render time regardless of collection size, ~90% reduction in DOM nodes, smoother scrolling
performance_optimizations.implementation:
1. Install react-window or @tanstack/virtual
2. Wrap the image grid with FixedSizeGrid or VirtualGrid
3. Adjust item size calculations for responsive grid
4. Implement proper keyboard navigation for accessibility
5. Add scroll position restoration for navigation
performance_optimizations.tradeoffs: Adds ~8KB dependency (react-window), slightly more complex grid layout logic, requires fixed item heights

performance_optimizations.title: Cache Image objects in BannerCanvas to prevent reloading
performance_optimizations.description: BannerCanvas creates new Image() objects on every render for both background and element images. This triggers redundant image decoding even when the source URLs haven't changed, causing visual flicker and CPU overhead.
performance_optimizations.rationale: The renderCanvas function creates `new Image()` instances for background and elements on every call. Even with browser caching, each new Image instance triggers decoding overhead. The canvas re-renders frequently during drag/resize operations, multiplying the impact.
performance_optimizations.currentMetric: New Image() creation on every canvas render (~30-60 times during a drag operation)
performance_optimizations.expectedImprovement: Eliminate redundant image loading/decoding, smoother drag/resize interactions, ~20% faster canvas updates
performance_optimizations.implementation:
1. Create a useRef-based image cache Map<string, HTMLImageElement>
2. Check cache before creating new Image instances
3. Preload images when URLs change using useEffect
4. Use onload callbacks to trigger re-render only when image is ready
5. Implement cache eviction for removed images
performance_optimizations.tradeoffs: Slightly more memory usage for cached images, need to handle cache invalidation when images change

performance_optimizations.title: Memoize keyboard shortcut handlers in App.tsx
performance_optimizations.description: The `getDefaultShortcuts()` function is called on every App render, creating new function objects for all shortcut handlers. These new references cause the useKeyboardShortcuts hook to re-register event listeners unnecessarily.
performance_optimizations.rationale: App.tsx calls getDefaultShortcuts() with inline arrow functions on every render. This creates new function references that fail React's referential equality checks, potentially causing unnecessary effect re-runs and memory churn.
performance_optimizations.currentMetric: New shortcut handler objects created on every App render
performance_optimizations.expectedImprovement: Stable function references, fewer effect re-runs, reduced memory allocation during interaction
performance_optimizations.implementation:
1. Wrap the getDefaultShortcuts call with useMemo
2. Use useCallback for individual handlers passed to getDefaultShortcuts
3. Add proper dependency arrays referencing only truly dynamic values
4. Consider moving shortcut definitions outside component if possible
performance_optimizations.tradeoffs: Slight increase in code complexity with additional memoization hooks

performance_optimizations.title: Add request deduplication for concurrent API calls
performance_optimizations.description: The LLM service doesn't deduplicate identical concurrent requests. When users rapidly click generate or the voice agent fires multiple similar requests, duplicate API calls are made, wasting credits and bandwidth.
performance_optimizations.rationale: Without request deduplication, double-clicking 'Generate' or rapid voice commands can trigger multiple expensive AI API calls with identical parameters. This wastes user credits ($0.03-$0.24 per call) and creates race conditions in the UI.
performance_optimizations.currentMetric: No protection against duplicate concurrent requests
performance_optimizations.expectedImprovement: Prevent duplicate API calls, save user credits, cleaner UI state management, ~50% reduction in accidental duplicate requests
performance_optimizations.implementation:
1. Create a request deduplication layer in api.ts
2. Hash request parameters to create unique keys
3. Return existing promise for in-flight identical requests
4. Implement configurable TTL for request deduplication (e.g., 2 seconds)
5. Add optional override for intentional duplicate requests
performance_optimizations.tradeoffs: Slightly more complex request handling, need to handle edge cases for intentionally repeated requests

metadata.potentialSavings: ~200-400ms TTI improvement, 90% reduction in unnecessary renders for large galleries
